description: The workspace's Zobrx subscription: plan, modules, current billing period with its END date (the renewal/expiry date), days left, trial end, and the order allowance for the period (assigned, used, remaining, unlimited, exhausted). Use for 'when is my renewal', 'is my plan active', 'how many orders are left'. The seller sees the same on Settings in the app.
name: get_subscription_status
title: Get subscription and renewal status
